item7.sentence: The time reversals of items 4 and 5 are not vacuous: `Causal.minkowski_pastBoundaryChart` (item 3), read at `(minkowski n).dual` through `Causality.dual_dual` (`rfl`), inhabits `FutureBoundaryChart` at `0` for the half-space `{t > 0}`.
item7.probe: campaign/T-abs-lineref-docstrings/Probe.lean § 4, section Item7, compiled without error: (i) `example (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) : (minkowski n).dual.FutureBoundaryChart (minkowskiPosHalfSpace n) (minkowskiChartBox n) 0 := minkowski_pastBoundaryChart hn` (the stated type, by the term itself); (ii) the same by `rw [FutureBoundaryChart, Causality.dual_dual]; exact minkowski_pastBoundaryChart hn`; (iii) `(minkowski n).dual.dual = minkowski n := rfl`; (iv) item 4's globally hyperbolic form GloballyHyperbolic.not_futureBoundaryChart_of_flrwTypeA at (minkowski n).dual (dual_tarentin, dual_globallyHyperbolic) refutes the time-reversed (A) at the half-space; (v) item 5's GloballyHyperbolic.not_futureBoundaryChart_of_flrwTypeB at (minkowski n).dual (dual_causallyArcConnectedOn of minkowski_posHalfSpace_flrwType_check) refutes the time-reversed (B), S ⊆ I⁺(x, W), at the half-space. So the sentence's claim holds, and the time reversals apply with their conclusion inhabited, not only typecheck.

curation_note.where: papers/ett/certificate/curation.toml:1106, row def:causally_connected, paper_findings[2] (the master's; not touched)
curation_note.reads: Under causal arc-connectedness and causality, connectedness follows from CurvesExtend (CauchyExtension.lean:82), here as a hypothesis (causallyConnectedCurves_of_curvesExtend).
curation_note.should_read: Under causal arc-connectedness and causality, connectedness follows from CurvesExtend (Causality.CurvesExtend, Causal.CauchyExtension), here as a hypothesis (causallyConnectedCurves_of_curvesExtend).
curation_note.note: The shorter 'CurvesExtend (Causal.CauchyExtension)' that the target block proposes is also correct; the form above matches ChainsCurves.lean:48 as now written. The master may also add that the hypothesis holds on every T1, second countable space (Causality.curvesExtend_of_t1_secondCountable, Causal.CurvesExtendSecondCountable), which the note does not say.

findings: Library prose, not the paper. CurvesExtendSecondCountable.lean:20–24: 'The fact it discharges, as the library states it (…)' quotes a docstring of Causality.CurvesExtend that ends 'the library does not prove it for topological spacetimes'. The master amended that docstring when this module graduated (7923138b). It now says the fact is a theorem on every T1, second countable space (CauchyExtension.lean:84–87). The quote is historical. This target replaced only the reference on :20. The master may read 'as the library stated it before this module'.

Library prose. CurvesExtendSecondCountable.lean:108–114, the SCOPE bullet 'Library prose that this module makes outdated … They are for the master to amend at graduation', is itself outdated. Both items were amended at 7923138b. Its reference `Causal/CurvesExtend.lean:97–98` (:112) no longer holds the quoted 'whether CurvesExtend holds in every strongly causal spacetime is open here', which no longer appears in CurvesExtend.lean at all: :90–103 now say the general statement is proved elsewhere. That reference is stale through a content change, not a line shift, so the planner's line-mapping probe cannot see it. It is outside the 16 and was left unchanged.

Ladder references, not Lean. IsolatedLineConjoined.lean:19 cites `programme/ladder.toml:1799–1800` for the quoted sentence 'The witness stays the half carrying causally_arc_connected and causally_plain.', which is no longer in the ladder. :24 cites `programme/ladder.toml:2021–2023` for a passage now at ladder :2591–2595, in different wording (the > block on :21–24 paraphrases an older ladder text). These are line references into programme/ladder.toml, outside this target's 16 and outside the files T-lad-lineref-names edits. They need a follow-up that cites the ladder entry by its from/to instead.

The other line references in the nine modules were checked by eye, and each still points at its declaration: CausalConvex.lean:153, Inextensible.lean:184, Properties.lean:144, Morphism.lean:832, Minkowski.lean:76/:110/:121/:132, Remarks/SingularRowsCauchyExt.lean:191, Flat/Develop.lean:1614 (the docstring line above the theorem). CurvesExtendSecondCountable.lean:103's `Causal/CurvesExtend.lean:90–99` covers the long-ray conjecture (:94–99) within the bullet :90–103.
questions: 'The declaration's full name and its module'. Reading taken: the name is written as the library's docstrings and the target's example write it, relative to the root namespace Causal (`Causality.CurvesExtend` (`Causal.CauchyExtension`), the form of T-abs-sc-open-hoist part (c) at CurvesExtend.lean:515–516), with Causal. kept for root-level names (Causal.isolatedLine_scOpen_without_tarentin). Where the name already stands right before the reference (CurvesExtend.lean:7–8, LevinUtility.lean:7–8, SubArc.lean:53–54, IsolatedLineConjoined.lean:22–23, MinkowskiFutureOneConnected.lean:108–109, CurvesExtendSecondCountable.lean:96 and :109–110), only the file:line became the module, so no name is repeated. Where the name was bare on the reference line itself (CurvesExtend.lean:10, Flat/CauchyComplete.lean:2402, FlrwTypeClosedAmbient.lean:320), it gained its namespace. The fully qualified names are listed under `references` and resolved by the probe. If the author wants fully qualified names (Causal.Causality.…) written out in docstrings, that is a uniform rewrite of the library, not of these 16.
kb_proposals: A docstring-only edit is checked by two dumps: the constant dump (kb/0063) must be byte-identical, and a hash of each findDocString?/getModuleDoc? entry of the edited modules must differ exactly at the edited blocks (campaign/T-abs-lineref-docstrings/Probe.lean § 1–2).

A line reference can go stale with no line moving: when the cited text is amended in place (CurvesExtendSecondCountable.lean:112 into CurvesExtend.lean's SCOPE, amended at 7923138b). A difflib line-mapping probe cannot see this. Cite a declaration by name, and a passage by its declaration or section, not by line.
notes: No import, statement, proof or constant changed: both dumps are byte-identical. Every changed line is inside a block comment. Eight files keep their line count. FlrwTypeClosedAmbient gains 2 lines, inside item 7, which is within the dispatch's 3. Fitting the sentence into item 7's six existing lines would have pushed each of them to about 135 characters. Its declarations therefore move down by 2 from :60 on. Nothing outside the module cites a current line of it, as `line_counts` says. The archived probe campaign/T-abs-meets-cauchy-antisymmetry-sharp/Probe.lean, programme/ladder.toml and the curation file were not touched, and tools/ladder.py emit-lean was not run. The build rebuilt 201 modules downstream of CurvesExtend, CurvesExtendSecondCountable, SubArc and Flat.CauchyComplete. After it, `lake build --no-build Causal` is up to date. The lake env lean runs wrote nothing in the package. The before/after dumps and the check outputs are under /tmp/T-abs-lineref-docstrings/ (outside the repository): before/, after/, check.json, build.log, scripts/apply.py, scripts/check.py, scripts/DumpAll.lean.
